summary: Iteration 9: Tested new admin Payment Gateway settings (Razorpay + PayU) end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest passed (GET returns masked secrets + configured flags, PUT preserves masked secrets, PUT updates real secrets, auth required, razorpay create-order + payu initiate work with DB-loaded keys). Frontend: Admin Panel > Settings tab renders Payment Gateways section with both Razorpay and PayU subsections; 'Configured' badges (emerald) shown; Key ID/Merchant Key visible; secrets masked with ******** (password inputs); eye toggle buttons render; Save Payment Settings button works with success toast 'Payment gateway settings saved'; post-save GET refresh keeps secrets masked. Reminders and SMTP sections unaffected.

minor.issue: When a partial settings doc exists in DB (e.g., razorpay_key_id set but razorpay_key_secret missing), the response OMITS the razorpay_key_secret / payu_merchant_salt keys entirely instead of returning empty string. Frontend still works because it defaults, but the API contract is inconsistent. Suggest always returning all fields with '' or MASK.

razorpay_configured is derived only from razorpay_key_id (not both id AND secret). A doc with key_id but empty secret would report configured=true but Razorpay client would fail. Use `bool(key_id and key_secret)`.
get_admin_user(request) is called twice (line 332 and again inside audit_logs insert line 355). Minor redundancy — reuse the admin object from the first call.

passed_tests: GET /api/admin/payment-settings returns all fields with razorpay_key_secret=='********' and payu_merchant_salt=='********'
PUT /api/admin/payment-settings with masked secrets preserves existing DB secret values
PUT /api/admin/payment-settings with real secrets overwrites DB values
POST /api/razorpay/create-order works after settings save (dynamic key loading from DB)
POST /api/payu/initiate returns valid params with dynamic PayU key and SHA512 hash
UI: Admin Panel > Settings tab -> Payment Gateways section renders with data-testid='admin-payment-settings'
UI: Razorpay & PayU 'Configured' badges show emerald when keys present
UI: Key ID = 'rzp_test_SY4wkkjcQo4e5i', Merchant Key = 'wRL2ZK', Base URL = 'https://test.payu.in/_payment'
UI: Both secret fields are password-type inputs prefilled with '********' (masked)
UI: Save Payment Settings button triggers PUT and shows 'Payment gateway settings saved' sonner toast
UI: Post-save GET refresh keeps secrets masked; no leakage in DOM
action_items: (Optional) In GET /admin/payment-settings, always return razorpay_key_secret and payu_merchant_salt as '' or MASK for consistent API contract even when DB doc is partial.
(Optional) Compute razorpay_configured = bool(key_id and key_secret) — same for payu_configured — to avoid misleading badges when only one field is set.
(Optional) Avoid double-calling get_admin_user in PUT /admin/payment-settings (reuse the first call's result for audit_log insert).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/payments.py _get_razorpay/_get_payu: settings collection is queried on EVERY payment API call (create-order, verify, webhook, payu initiate). Consider a small in-memory cache with TTL or invalidate-on-save pattern to avoid extra DB hit per payment request.

routes/admin.py update_payment_settings: reinitializes config.razorpay_client on save, but this only affects the current worker process. If backend runs multiple uvicorn workers, other workers still hold stale client — the dynamic _get_razorpay() reload already handles this per-call so the reinit block is largely redundant.
routes/payments.py _get_payu: keeps env-fallback via os.environ.get but _get_razorpay uses config.RAZORPAY_KEY_ID. Inconsistent access pattern; standardize on one approach.

AdminSettings.js line 12: single 900+ line file if you keep adding sections. Consider splitting PaymentGatewaySettings, ReminderSettings, SmtpSettings into separate components under /components/admin/settings/.
seed_data_creation: Test suite writes/restores payment_gateways settings doc in DB. Final test (test_zzz_restore_env_credentials) restores original .env-matching values so live payment flows continue to work.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payment Gateway settings feature fully working. All backend endpoints (GET/PUT /admin/payment-settings) mask/preserve secrets correctly. Dynamic key loading in _get_razorpay/_get_payu confirmed via successful razorpay create-order and payu initiate calls. Frontend renders as expected with data-testid attributes: admin-payment-settings, razorpay-key-id, razorpay-key-secret, payu-merchant-key, payu-merchant-salt, payu-base-url, save-payment-btn. Only minor optional improvements suggested (partial-doc GET consistency, configured flag on both fields, double get_admin_user call).
